_source: Read-only catalog queries against Omen production (project xyudxfhqejbwvjngiwhw), 2026-10-01, founder-approved in session. Copied verbatim from the query results. Used by scripts/db/catalog.js to prove the scratch snapshot equals production. Updated 2026-10-02: the seven league_office_* tables were dropped in production (migration 20261002231212 drop_league_office); their entries were removed here and the remainder re-verified against a fresh read-only read of production.
